name: Inpatient Hospital
description: Acute inpatient care paid under IPPS using DRGs. Subject to mandatory Hospital VBP, HRRP, and HAC reduction payment adjustments. FY2027 IPPS final rule (CMS-1849-F, released July 31, 2026; effective Oct 1, 2026): 2.3% net update for hospitals meeting quality-reporting and EHR requirements.
innovationModels: Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement Expanded (CJR-X)

name: Outpatient Hospital
description: Hospital outpatient and ASC services paid under OPPS/ASC fee schedule using Ambulatory Payment Classifications. CY2027 OPPS final rule (CMS-1850-F, released Nov 4, 2026): 2.3% payment update; separately payable 340B-acquired drugs paid at ASP minus 28% (ASP minus 33.4% had been proposed); the 340B-remedy offset on non-drug services rises from 0.5% to 2% a year; site-neutral, PFS-equivalent payment extends to certain imaging without contrast at excepted off-campus departments; second year of the three-year inpatient-only list phase-out.
innovationModels: Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement Expanded (CJR-X)
Wasteful and Inappropriate Service Reduction (WISeR) Model

name: Physician / Professional Services
description: Physician and eligible professional services paid under the PFS. Subject to QPP (MIPS or Advanced APM) payment adjustments. CY2027 conversion factors (CY2027 PFS final rule, released Nov 4, 2026): $32.9548 for qualifying APM participants and $32.6286 for all others — down 1.83% and 2.31% respectively, as OBBBA's one-year 2.5% CY2026 increase expired.
innovationModels: Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement Expanded (CJR-X)
Value in Opioid Use Disorder Treatment
Wasteful and Inappropriate Service Reduction (WISeR) Model
Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions (ACCESS) Model

name: Skilled Nursing Facility
description: Post-acute SNF care paid under SNF PPS (PDPM). Subject to SNF VBP payment adjustments. Eligible as downstream episode participant for surgical and medical bundles.
innovationModels: Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement Expanded (CJR-X)

name: Home Health
description: Skilled home health services paid under HH PPS (PDGM). Subject to the nationwide expanded HHVBP Model (performance measured from 2023). The CY2027 HH PPS final rule (CMS-1844-F, released Nov 4, 2026) estimates a 2.4% ($415M) aggregate increase — a 2.1% payment update plus 0.3% from the updated outlier fixed-dollar-loss amount — and separately finalized a temporary -3.0% adjustment to the 30-day base rate, alongside recalibrated case-mix weights and LUPA thresholds.
innovationModels: Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement Expanded (CJR-X)

name: Hospice
description: Palliative per-diem care for beneficiaries with a terminal prognosis of ≤6 months. Hospice spending included in ACO benchmark expenditures.

name: Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility
description: Intensive inpatient rehab paid under IRF PPS using Case-Mix Groups. Eligible as downstream participant in surgical episode bundles.
innovationModels: Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement Expanded (CJR-X)

name: End-Stage Renal Disease
description: Dialysis services paid under ESRD PPS as a bundled per-treatment rate. Home dialysis encouraged through expanded coverage and transitional add-on payments. CY2027 ESRD PPS final rule (Oct 28, 2026): base rate $297.52 (from $281.71), including $12.85 to bring phosphate binders into the bundle; total facility payments up about 2.7%.

name: Oncology
description: Cancer diagnosis, treatment, and management paid under PFS (with Part B drug buy-and-bill) or Part D. Oncology practices subject to MIPS oncology specialty set.

name: Behavioral Health
description: Mental health and SUD services paid under PFS. Mental Health Parity applies to MA and Medicaid managed care. OTP Medicare bundled payment for opioid treatment.
innovationModels: Value in Opioid Use Disorder Treatment
Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions (ACCESS) Model

name: Medicare Advantage / Health Plan
description: Medicare Advantage (Part C) managed care plans receive risk-adjusted capitation payments per enrollee. Plans take on full insurance risk for Medicare benefits.
innovationModels: Achieving Healthcare Efficiency through Accountable Design (AHEAD)

name: Prescription Drug (Part D)
description: Outpatient prescription drug benefit administered by private Part D plan sponsors. IRA 2022 created Medicare Drug Price Negotiation, out-of-pocket cap, and manufacturer rebate rules.
